title: Video chapters / titled breakpoints (per language)
description: Canonical chapter markers for one language, produced via the worksheet export/import round-trip (the CLI never calls an LLM: an agent fills titles + breakpoints, the CLI validates & registers). Rendered into a YouTube description timecode block and available for X/thread promo. The first chapter MUST start at 0ms; chapters are monotonic, non-overlapping, and within the video duration.

duration_ms.description: Total media duration; every chapter start must be < this.

chapters.description: Ordered chapter markers. chapters[0].start_ms must be 0.
